theme: warehouse shelves facing shifting shopping fashions
title: Trend-Tail Slotting: p90 Order-Wave Picking Distance
strategies: identity placement: SKU i in slot i (matches the checker's internal baseline)

classic ABC / global velocity slotting: rank SKUs by total pick frequency pooled over ALL scenarios and place fast movers closest to the depot, one SKU at a time, ignoring who they are co-purchased with

bootstrap + tail-pooled co-purchase affinity: use a rough velocity layout to identify the costliest scenarios, build a co-purchase affinity graph (edge weight = orders sharing both SKUs) using ONLY orders from those tail scenarios, and re-slot by global frequency plus a boost on each SKU's weighted degree in that tail-only graph, pulling tail-central SKUs toward the depot without displacing the genuinely high-velocity assortment
full simulated-annealing / local-search relocation directly on the p90 objective (swap two SKUs' slots, accept if the resulting p90 scenario cost improves)
